inline_prompts: You are given a simple connected undirected graph with N vertices numbered 1 through N and M edges numbered 1 through M. Edge i connects vertices u_i and v_i, and has a label w_i. Among all simple paths (paths that do not pass through the same vertex more than once) from vertex 1 to vertex N, find the minimum XOR of the labels of the edges on the path. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N M u_1 v_1 w_1 u_2 v_2 w_2 \vdots u_M v_M w_M Output Print the answer. Constraints - 2 \leq N \leq 10 - N-1 \leq M \leq \frac{N(N-1)}{2} - 1 \leq u_i < v_i \leq N - 0 \leq w_i < 2^{60} - The given graph is a simple connected undirected graph.
